name: Bendi
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

earlier_scan.note: Glottolog lists only subclassification notes (Kutsch Lojenga 1994; Bokula & Irumu 1994); no grammar or phonology known

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid record and reference table for bend1260 (3 refs: Gikwa 1997 'Le parler des mabendi' [grammar_sketch, MA thesis ISP Bunia]; Liesenborghs 1934 'Over Taal en Oorsprong der Mabendi', Congo 15(II): 35-38 [wordlist, 4 pp.]; van Bulck 1954 [overview]); classification comment cites Liesenborghs 1934, Kutsch Lojenga 1994: 451, Bokula & Irumu 1994: 226.

van Bulck, Gaston. 1954. Mission linguistique 1949-1951. (Mémoires de l'Institut Royal Colonial Belge, Section des Sciences morales et politiques, T. XXXI, fasc. 5.) Bruxelles: IRCB. 77 pp. Open PDF at KAOWARSOM (https://www.kaowarsom.be/en/memoir_95).
sources.note: Nothing. p. 52 ('B. Groupe Mamvu-Lese', item 6): 'Le parler des Mabendi, appelés Ndra par les 'Bale en territoire de Djugu. Ce parler est très proche de celui des Balese-Otsodo. S. 72.' -- a survey/classification inventory entry only; no accent, stress or tone remark for Mabendi anywhere in the memoir (grep accent/ton/intonation gives only a generic remark on 'diversités d'accent' among Bantu dialects).
two-line stub (Mangbutu-Lese; 32,000 speakers 1991, ref Ethnologue 18); nothing on phonology

sources.note: Fullest phonological descriptions of the Mangbutu-Efe (Mamvu-Lese) group, with tone and 'Akzent' sections; the 1971 comparative chapter (pp. 81-101) covers the member lects and may include remarks on Mabendi/Bendi, which van Bulck 1954 places 'très proche' of Balese-Otsodo. Would at minimum supply the group-level prosodic profile.
